subject: Culture
title: Liberation Day Across Europe
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Liberation Day Across Europe.

hook.text: The Netherlands celebrates May 5th. France honors June 18th. Every country freed from Nazis picks its own date.

buildup.text: Liberation days mark the end of occupation. They honor resistance fighters and allied forces.

discovery.text: Norway's Liberation Day is May 8th. The same day, Russia celebrates Victory Day—but a day later, on May 9th.

twist.text: Germany has no liberation day. For decades it remembered May 8th as defeat. Only recently it became 'liberation.'

climax.text: The same war ends on different dates in different countries. History isn't one story—it's many.

punchline.text: Liberation feels different depending on which side of the border.

quiz.question: How did Germany traditionally view May 8th before reframing it?
